cohort: 50 female patients admitted to a Gynecology OPD in a tertiary care center in Gujarat, India, undergoing Nondecent Vaginal Hysterectomy for various indications, primarily abnormal uterine bleeding.
finding: 76% of patients underwent Nondecent Vaginal Hysterectomy due to abnormal uterine bleeding, and only 2% experienced an intraoperative complication (bladder injury).
